item: reader copies badge and Related leave out what an outlet repeats on half its pages
summary: Field test 2026-11-14 row 67 (report 7.1): one hbl.fi article showed ~12 unrelated hbl.fi pages as near-identical copies and Related ranked by 17 shared keywords that were all the platform's page text. Read-time only, nothing stored or recomputed (the mass import runs): the copies badge signs every doc without the UNION of the involved sources' repeated text: the word 5-shingles on at least half of each source's 20 most recent DISTINCT pages (near-identical pages count once, judged on what is left once a provisional template from a first count is removed, or on near-identical titles, so a heavy template that makes whole pages alike is still learned and a live blog is still one page; under 8 distinct pages nothing is learned), after src.ingest.furniture.strip_furniture, which is also applied to the compared docs. The union (not per-doc) keeps a wire footer one outlet repeats from splitting its copy from the same item at a small outlet (independent read). A doc emptied by the drop is never a copy (two empty sets have equal sentinel signatures). Related and the badge's candidate ranking leave out keywords on at least half of the source's newest 500 articles (from 10 articles up). Both cached per source 30 min. A story an outlet ran twice is on two pages, not half, so it is still found. Briefing and corpus-coordination clusters are unchanged (near_duplicate_clusters gains an optional drop_shingles they do not pass).
